 If not CHECK_ISBT_PREFIX(substr(:ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id,1,5)) then

 initialise_windows;
 show_error('16110');

 clear_form(no_validate);
 initialise_windows;
 end if;
 END IF;

END;

PROCEDURE Query_Master_Details(rel_id Relation,detail VARCHAR2) IS
 oldmsg VARCHAR2(2); -- Old Message Level Setting
 reldef VARCHAR2(5); -- Relation Deferred Setting
BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Variable(s)
 --
 reldef := Get_Relation_Property(rel_id, DEFERRED_COORDINATION);
 oldmsg := :System.Message_Level;
 --
 -- If NOT Deferred, Goto detail and execute the query.
 --
 IF reldef = 'FALSE' THEN
 Go_Block(detail);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 :System.Message_Level := '10';
 Execute_Query;
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Relation is deferred, mark the detail block as un-coordinated
 --
 Set_Block_Property(detail, COORDINATION_STATUS, NON_COORDINATED);
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 RAISE;
END Query_Master_Details;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Clear_All_Master_Details IS
 mastblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Initial Master Block Cusing Coord
 coordop VARCHAR2(30); -- Operation Causing the Coord
 trigblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Cur Block On-Clear-Details Fires On
 startitm VARCHAR2(61); -- Item in which cursor started
 frmstat VARCHAR2(15); -- Form Status
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 curdtl VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Detail Block

 FUNCTION First_Changed_Block_Below(Master VARCHAR2)
 RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 retblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Return Block
 BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Vars
 --
 curblk := Master;
 currel := Get_Block_Property(curblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 --
 -- While there exists another relation for this block
 --
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 --
 -- Get the name of the detail block
 --
 curblk := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 --
 -- If this block has changes, return its name
 --
 IF ( Get_Block_Property(curblk, STATUS) IN('CHANGED','INSERT') ) THEN
 RETURN curblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- No changes, recursively look for changed blocks below
 --
 retblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(curblk);
 --
 -- If some block below is changed, return its name
 --
 IF retblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 RETURN retblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Consider the next relation
 --
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- No changed blocks were found
 --
 RETURN NULL;
 END First_Changed_Block_Below;

BEGIN
 --
 -- Init Local Vars
 --
 mastblk := :System.Master_Block;
 coordop := :System.Coordination_Operation;
 trigblk := :System.Trigger_Block;
 startitm := :System.Trigger_Item;
 frmstat := :System.Form_Status;

 --
 -- If the coordination operation is anything but CLEAR_RECORD or
 -- SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS, then continue checking.
 --
 IF coordop NOT IN ('CLEAR_RECORD', 'SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS') THEN
 --
 -- If we're processing the driving master block...
 --
 IF mastblk = trigblk THEN
 --
 -- If something in the form is changed, find the
 -- first changed block below the master
 --
 IF frmstat = 'CHANGED' THEN
 curblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(mastblk);
 --
 -- If we find a changed block below, go there
 -- and Ask to commit the changes.
 --
 IF curblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 Go_Block(curblk);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(ASK_COMMIT);
 --
 -- If user cancels commit dialog, raise error
 --
 IF NOT ( :System.Form_Status = 'QUERY'
 OR :System.Block_Status = 'NEW' ) THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 --
 -- Clear all the detail blocks for this master without
 -- any further asking to commit.
 --
 currel := Get_Block_Property(trigblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 curdtl := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 IF Get_Block_Property(curdtl, STATUS) <> 'NEW' THEN
 Go_Block(curdtl);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(NO_VALIDATE);
 IF :System.Block_Status <> 'NEW' THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- Put cursor back where it started
 --
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 END IF;
 RAISE;

END Clear_All_Master_Details;

/*
 For scenarios where don_inter pkg throws
 Err44. when the term date is the same day OR +1
 to local chapter date.
 Such interdictions are handled in this routine.
 
 Release_date is updated, so these won't be picked by don inter pkg.
*/
PROCEDURE delete_donor_inter_local (
 p_donor_id IN VARCHAR2,
 p_chapter_id IN VARCHAR2,
 p_inter_code IN VARCHAR2,
 p_originated_from IN VARCHAR2,
 p_reason_code IN VARCHAR2,
 p_transaction_id IN VARCHAR2,
 p_comments IN VARCHAR2,
 p_term_reason IN VARCHAR2,
 p_program_id IN VARCHAR2,
 p_user_id IN VARCHAR2,
 p_chp_sysdate DATE,
 p_status OUT VARCHAR2
) IS
 t_note_id VARCHAR2(10);
 t_status VARCHAR2(1000);
BEGIN
 p_status := 'OK';

 BEGIN
 SELECT note_id
 INTO t_note_id
 FROM donor_interdictions
 WHERE donor_id = p_donor_id
 AND transaction_id = p_transaction_id
 AND inter_code = p_inter_code
 AND NVL(originated_from, ' ') = NVL(p_originated_from, ' ')
 AND NVL(reason_code, ' ') = NVL(p_reason_code, ' ')
 AND rownum < 2; 
 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 p_status := 'ERR. Inter Code could not be retrieved';
 RETURN;
 END;

 BEGIN
 generate_note(p_comments, p_chapter_id, p_program_id, p_user_id, p_chp_sysdate, t_note_id,
 t_status);
 IF t_status != 'OK' THEN
 p_status := t_status;
 RETURN;
 END IF;
 END;

 BEGIN
 UPDATE donor_interdictions
 SET
 term_date = nvl(term_date, p_chp_sysdate),
 release_date = p_chp_sysdate,
 term_reason = p_term_reason,
 release_user = p_user_id
 WHERE
 donor_id = p_donor_id
 AND transaction_id = p_transaction_id
 AND inter_code = p_inter_code
 AND NVL(originated_from, ' ') = NVL(p_originated_from, ' ')
 AND NVL(reason_code, ' ') = NVL(p_reason_code, ' ')
 AND release_date IS NULL;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 p_status := 'Err33. Unable to terminate in donor interdiction'
 || substr(sqlerrm, 1, 100);
 RETURN;
 END;


END delete_donor_inter_local;

PROCEDURE generate_note (
 p_comments IN VARCHAR2,
 p_chapter_id IN VARCHAR2,
 p_program_id IN VARCHAR2,
 p_user_id IN VARCHAR2,
 p_chp_sysdate IN DATE,
 p_note_id IN OUT VARCHAR2,
 p_status OUT VARCHAR2
) IS

 t_seq_no NUMBER;
 t_note_id VARCHAR2(10);
 err_flag VARCHAR2(1);
 err_msg VARCHAR2(50);
BEGIN
 IF p_comments IS NULL THEN
 p_status := 'OK';
 RETURN;
 END IF;
 IF p_chapter_id IS NULL OR p_program_id IS NULL THEN
 p_status := 'Err3. Chapter_ID or Program ID is NULL';
 RETURN;
 END IF;

 IF p_note_id IS NULL THEN /* generate new note id */
 BEGIN
 SELECT
 to_char(note_sequence.NEXTVAL)
 INTO t_note_id
 FROM
 dual;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 p_status := 'Err4. Could not generate note_sequence '
 || substr(sqlerrm, 1, 100);
 END;

 p_note_id := t_note_id;
 --end if;
 t_seq_no := 1;
 ELSE /* old note id exists*/
 BEGIN
 SELECT
 MAX(note_sequence)
 INTO t_seq_no
 FROM
 central_notes
 WHERE
 note_id = p_note_id;

 t_seq_no := t_seq_no + 1;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 t_seq_no := 1;
 END;
 END IF;

 BEGIN
 INSERT INTO central_notes (
 note_id,
 note_sequence,
 program_id,
 insert_date,
 insert_user,
 chapter_id,
 note
 ) VALUES (
 p_note_id,
 t_seq_no,
 p_program_id,
 p_chp_sysdate,
 p_user_id,
 p_chapter_id,
 p_comments
 );

 IF SQL%notfound THEN
 p_status := 'Err5. Unable to insert note in central notes '
 || substr(sqlerrm, 1, 100);
 RETURN;
 END IF;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 p_status := 'Err6. Unable to Insert note '
 || substr(sqlerrm, 1, 100);
 RETURN;
 END;

 p_status := 'OK';
END generate_note;

 l_print_id VARCHAR2(40);
 l_error VARCHAR2(1000);
BEGIN
 populate_chapter_ID(l_chp_id, l_print_id, l_error);
 IF l_error IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF l_error in ('9776','9777') THEN
 show_error(l_error); -- Message Type
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));
 pause;
 END IF; 
 exit_form(no_validate);
 ELSE
 :global.chapter_id := l_chp_id;
 :global.user_printer_id := l_print_id;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));pause;
 exit_form(no_validate); 
END;
